read.title: Budget Request: Q1 Social Media Campaign
read.text:
Hi Daniel,

I'd like to request an additional budget of $8,000 for our Q1 social media campaign. Our current budget covers only two influencer partnerships, but we need at least five to reach our target audience in the U.S.

Based on last year's results, each partnership brought in around $3,000 in sales, so the extra cost should pay for itself within two months. I've also compared three agencies and chose the most cost-effective option.

Please find attached a detailed estimate and a breakdown of the expected return. If approved by December 5, we can sign contracts before the holiday season.

Please let me know if you need any further information.

Best regards,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short email to your manager requesting a budget for an online Excel course for your team, with the amount and the reason.
hints: Please let me know if you need any further information.
write.model:
Hi Ms. Park,

I'd like to request a budget of $1,500 for an online Excel course for our team of five. Many of us spend hours on monthly reports, and this training will help us work much faster. I believe it will save us time and money in the long run. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Best regards,
Minsu
